checkpoint.title: Route 10's north grass: a hard reset timed for a shiny Ekans, Sweet Scent, the catch, its summary's star, saved

events.why: The soonest shiny Ekans of the table: seed 08F5 (press 33050 ms after the reset), advance 988, Lv 11. SID 9011 was read once from this save's memory. seed_shift 8: what 01's end save adds to the Sevii table's seeds on mGBA, measured. Oddish, last in the party, knows Sweet Scent.

metadata.notes: mGBA only: the Sevii table plus 8 holds the seeds of 01-route10-grass's end save after backend.reset; a save made another number of saves later can shift them. A miss fails the checkpoint (wild_rng_not_shiny), the catch unsaved.
